dialogs.about: 손녀에게 보낼 소포를 아들과 함께 싸요

lines.en: I made this package for our granddaughter yesterday.
That's nice, Mom. Is it heavy?
I don't know. Can you weigh it?
Sure. It is not very heavy.
Please put some bubble wrap inside.
Of course. The cups will be safe then.
Who is the receiver on this paper?
My daughter. You are the sender.
Will they deliver it this week?
Yes, they will deliver it in three days.

dialogs.about: 우체국 창구에서 소포를 부치며 요금과 배송 조회를 물어요

lines.en: Hello. I want to send this parcel.
Good morning. Did you weigh it at home?
Yes, my son weighed it yesterday.
Good. I will check the postage now.
Can you send it express, please?
lines.ko: 빠른 우편으로 보내 주실 수 있어요?

lines.en: Yes. Express costs a little more money.
lines.ko: 네. 빠른 우편은 돈이 조금 더 들어요.

lines.en: That's fine. When will it arrive?
We will deliver it before Friday.
Thank you. Can I get a tracking number?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 배송 조회 번호를 받을 수 있어요?

lines.en: Of course. Here is your tracking number.
